brief: Determine the most probable cause of the availability degradation in INC-2026-IKEJA-001; distinguish transport, power, congestion, equipment, and cyber signatures.

impact.ncc_exposure_summary: Derived from Ikeja profile and current availability degradation.

evidence.summary: cell_availability_pct fell from 99.1 to 71.4 in Ikeja cluster IKJ-CL-04.
session_failure_rate_pct rose from 1.1 to 18.2 after the availability drop.
congestion_rate_pct rose from 4.1 to 11.8 on neighboring clusters as traffic rerouted.

agent_final_output.narrative: Ikeja shows a sharp cell availability drop followed by device-session failures and congestion on neighboring clusters. The pattern is most consistent with transport degradation on the IKJ-CL-04 corridor, with reroute congestion as a cascade. Confidence is high enough to brief mitigation, but field confirmation is still needed before naming a physical cable fault.

facts.claim: cell_availability_pct fell from 99.1 to 71.4 in Ikeja
session_failure_rate_pct rose from 1.1 to 18.2 after the availability drop
congestion_rate_pct rose from 4.1 to 11.8 on neighboring clusters

inferences.claim: pattern consistent with backbone transport degradation with reroute congestion as a cascade

recommendations.action: review reversible reroute options for human approval

open_questions: field confirmation is unavailable for the IKJ-CL-04 corridor
power-domain evidence for the affected cluster has not been provided
assumptions: fixture evidence is the complete scenario-001 evidence set
